name: Marcus Chen
psychographics: Values efficiency over cost; believes time is the only non-renewable resource.
current_solutions: Blue Apron for recipe variety, Instacart for grocery runs, and a robot vacuum to minimize chores.
frustration: Last Tuesday at 6:45 PM, the Instacart driver got lost in the parking garage of his office building and called him at 7:15 PM saying he was 'right outside' while Marcus was still stuck in traffic on I-25; his dinner was cold by the time he got home at 8:00 PM.
decision_style: Compares two options max, checks Prime eligibility, and buys the one that arrives tomorrow.
voice: Blunt and fast. Uses phrases like 'honestly,' 'time suck,' and 'just gimme.'
